_comment: The drop-in registry. DATA, not code — the spine reads this and mounts whatever is here.
Adding a component means adding an entry; it does not mean editing mez_studio.py.
Every entry declares: what it is, which rung it appears on, and HOW THE SPINE REACHES IT.
The spine calls; it never reimplements. That distinction is the whole point: the recurring
defect in this desk has been a capability that exists in the estate and cannot be reached
from here. A component absent from disk is reported as absent, never simulated.
static   a page served from the component's own repo (its studio) — shown in a frame
serve    a local server the component brings; the spine offers to start it, never assumes
cli      a command the component owns; the spine shows the command and runs it on request
panel    the spine's own surface over the component's data (estate, DOI ledger)
dome     the immersive rung: a world config mounted into zistgah/dome

_note_rungs: C33 / M4: the rung changes what is SHOWN, never what is computed. A console user and a dome
user get the same numbers. Your role selects a default rung; it does not gate a capability.
A rung is a projection of the LABORATORY, not of the systems on the bench. Each system keeps
its own surfaces; the rung changes only how this bench presents its own composition of them.

_architecture: MEZ IS A LABORATORY, NOT A CONTAINER.
GENIE, Kitab, HPS, ILM, the cyclers, robotics platforms, world models and simulators are
INDEPENDENT SYSTEMS. Each has its own ontology, runtime, artifacts, evolution and potentially
its own users. GENIE exists entirely without Mez. Kitab exists entirely without Mez. Mez
exists without either. That independence is desirable, not a gap to be closed.
This file is therefore NOT an inventory of parts. It is a table of INTERFACES: how a system
that already exists on its own terms can be reached, exercised and composed from here.
COMPOSITION  →  EXERCISE  →  OBSERVATION  →  SYNTHESIS  →  NEW ARTIFACT
The arrows are BIDIRECTIONAL. The workbench can use GENIE; GENIE can use workbench
capabilities. Kitab can participate in an exercise; an exercise can exercise Kitab.
AND SYNTHESIS DOES NOT MEAN INCORPORATION. GENIE + Kitab + a simulator may compose into
something new without either being modified. Where a genuinely reusable primitive falls out,
it is published back into the ecosystem as its own thing — not absorbed into the bench.
So a component here is never 'inside' Mez. `reached_by` says how to talk to it; `sovereign`
says it answers to itself. A component that stopped existing would leave a hole in this table,
